cases.old:
dstImpl.SetTimestamp(0)
				fmt.Fprintf(dstImpl, "failed to parse next event: %s\n", ui.ErroredColor.Sprint(err))

				fmt.Fprintf(dstImpl, "failed to parse next event: %s\n", ui.ErroredColor.Sprint(err))
